Hook-0.text: Your projects never stop: commits, pull requests, docs, failing tests.

Hook-2.text: So Momentum brings what matters to you, in one place.

Layers-0.text: Momentum gathers what needs you, from every project, into one ranked feed.

Layers-2.text: Beneath it, each project becomes a knowledge graph, checked on every change.

Layers-3.text: Beneath that, Claude Code does the work: planned, built, validated.

Layers-4.text: The result rises through the graph and lands in your feed, as one card.

Swipe-0.text: Swipe right to approve. The work starts by itself.

Swipe-1.text: Swipe left to send it back, with what should change.

Swipe-2.text: Or pull up, and ask about the card, right below it.

Loop-0.text: A trigger starts a run, in its own checkout of the project.

Loop-1.text: The run does the work, and summarization turns it into cards.

Loop-2.text: The guard checks every change before it lands on the main line.

Loop-3.text: Then it reaches your feed, and you decide.

Loop-4.text: Every project runs its own loop, all at once.

Graph-0.text: Take one small repository: thirty-eight files.

Graph-1.text: Momentum reads it into cards. Each card claims the files it accounts for.

Graph-2.text: Every card has a type, with its own colour and glyph.

Graph-3.text: Ask it anything. The answer comes from the cards, and links to each of them.

Graph-4.text: You verify a card by approving it.

Graph-5.text: When a run rewrites it, it comes back to you.

Measure-0.text: When a run finishes, everything it changed is summarized

Measure-1.text: into one card you can read.

Measure-2.text: And completeness is measured, not guessed: every area, every question.

Resolve-0.text: The consistency check finds where two cards disagree.

Resolve-1.text: Each issue comes with options, the best one already picked.

Schedule-0.text: Meanwhile, each automation runs on its schedule, or on an event.

Schedule-1.text: When your feed is full, the loops wait.

Schedule-2.text: Make room, and they go on. Never more work than you can review.

Learn-0.text: When you ask for the same thing in three different chats,

Learn-1.text: Momentum notices, and proposes the change once.

Learn-2.text: It takes effect on every project at once, and still waits for your review.

Line-0.text: Every run and every approval is one commit, on one straight line.

Line-1.text: Feed size, concurrent runs, models by risk: tuned to how you work.

Line-3.text: Momentum. Self-hosted, open source. Your attention, where it pays.
